notice: Independent student reference project. Retrieval is not gameplay verification. Game imagery belongs to its publishers.

collections.label: Characters
collections.note: Community character data. Introduction version is not the current game patch.

collections.label: Weapons
collections.note: Weapon attributes and ascension materials. Check refinement and level in-game.

collections.label: Brawlers
collections.note: Community reference data, not player statistics or a live tier list.

collections.label: Game modes
collections.note: Enabled does not mean currently in rotation. Check the event screen in-game.

collections.label: Maps
collections.note: Includes archived maps. Map status comes from the dataset, not the current event rotation.

collections.label: Java items
collections.note: Pinned Java 26.1 item registry. Numeric IDs are dataset IDs, not chat commands. This is not a claim of latest release.

collections.label: Bedrock items
collections.note: Pinned Bedrock 1.26.30 item data. Separate from Java; item IDs and recipes must not be mixed.

collections.label: Map & locations
collections.note: Provider map data may lag an in-game update. Match location labels against your current Battle Royale map.

collections.label: Shop cosmetics
collections.note: Battle Royale cosmetics in the returned shop snapshot. This is not the complete cosmetic archive. Prices and availability must be checked in-game.

collections.label: Combat & equipment starter reference
collections.note: 12 selected concepts, including five Paths. This is not every Path, character or build. HoYoWiki is publisher-hosted community content. Source review does not establish current optimal builds.

collections.label: Story skills & vehicle starter reference
collections.note: 12 selected records. Vehicle availability is documented in 1.27 for PS4, Xbox One and PC; inspect your edition’s store before buying. This excludes GTA Online businesses and is not a full vehicle database.

collections.label: Operations systems starter reference
collections.note: 12 selected systems, mainly based on Garena documentation. Regional services, unlocks and balance can differ. This is not the full item catalog; current client values take priority over historical patch examples.

collections.label: DOORS Hotel starter reference
collections.note: 12 selected threats and supplies for ordinary Hotel runs on PC and mobile. Not a complete DOORS encyclopedia. Modifiers and other floors can change these rules. Community article text was checked through the search index; direct Fandom access was blocked.

collections.label: PUBG PC starter reference
collections.note: 12 selected weapon families and maps from the publisher directory. This is not a full weapon-stat database or a current map-rotation list. Individual ammo, attachments, balance and availability should be checked in-game.

collections.label: Wuthering Waves starter reference
collections.note: 12 selected attributes, weapon families and progression terms. This is not a complete character roster, build ranking or item database. Community article text was checked through the search index; no in-game combat test was performed.
